reason: I re-ran the analysis and the positive remote_share coefficient held up. It was about 0.75 (p about 0.001) after adding the 2020 baseline patent rate and all the pre-period controls, region, segment and listed status. The report leaves out the post-period collaboration index, which is a mediator and shouldn't be controlled for. Its single specification matches the code, and the effect is modest but consistently positive.
